notes: The manual's hardware list says 100 ohm resistors, but the schematic label says 10kΩ. I used 100 ohm, following the text.
The speaker is not in the catalogue, so I added it as a new part type with ports POS (red lead) and NEG (black lead).
I read the breadboard hole positions from the image. The top rail holes tn.1, tn.6, tn.13 and tn.20 assume the rail's 5-hole groups are numbered consecutively. They are approximate.

Each speaker's red lead goes in row g of a top-half column (8, 17, 25). A resistor spans that column's top half (row f) to its bottom half (row e). A signal wire from pins 8, 7 and 6 enters row d of the same column.
The black ground wire runs from the Uno's GND pin next to AREF to the top negative rail, which the three speaker black leads also use.
The Uno's GND pin by pin 13 is mapped to GND.1. The catalogue does not say which of GND.1/2/3 is which header.
